parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the switch lever of the electrical switch, made of durable ABS plastic. It is the part that users interact with to toggle the switch on or off.
parts.Functional_description: The switch lever allows the user to manually change the electrical state between ON and OFF positions, controlling the circuit connection.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or pivots around a fixed axis to change the electrical contact state.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the switch, made of polycarbonate plastic. It houses the internal electrical contacts and supports the switch lever.
parts.Functional_description: The base body provides structural support and insulation for the internal electrical components, ensuring safe operation.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation, serving as the fixed housing for the switch mechanism.
